user.title: Connect to Tuya Cloud
user.description: Enter your Tuya IoT Platform credentials. Create an account at iot.tuya.com and link your Smart Life devices.

data_description.api_region: The data centre region for your account (eu, us, in, cn)
data_description.access_id: Client ID / Access ID from iot.tuya.com
data_description.access_secret: Client Secret / Access Secret from iot.tuya.com
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the Tuya cloud (60–3600 seconds)

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect — check your region and credentials.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This Tuya account is already configured.

data.swap_ggq_zones: Swap zone 1 & 2 valve outputs on dual-zone timers

data_description.local_scan_interval: How often to poll gateways over LAN (10–300 s)
data_description.cloud_fast_interval: How often to fetch schedule/timestamp data from the cloud (60–3600 s)
data_description.swap_ggq_zones: Enable if valve open/close shows on the wrong zone (e.g. Zone 2 shows active when Zone 1 is physically running)
data_description.gw_ip_: Enter the LAN IP address for this gateway to override auto-discovery (leave blank to use auto-scan)
